summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the Textual repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, internal TabsRenderable, Tabs widget with keyboard handling, animation via a _bar_position reactive and watch__active_tab_name, and action_range_clicked); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and now yields one Text with click spans applied last; Opacity merges blended colors into the existing style so click metadata is preserved; the layout resolver's Edge docstring documents size, min_size, and fraction (no behavior change, since min_size already existed); docs/reference/tabs.md added; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/widgets/test_tabs.py with tests/widgets/__init__.py. Existing tests are unchanged. Not verified by running: the test suite was not executed per instructions. Known limitations: the sandbox demo was skipped (optional); bar position is clamped to displayed tabs, so with duplicate names the highlight may be off; an empty label is treated as flexible by the resolver (size 0), shifting padding by one cell; keyboard paths have no tests because there is no key-event harness. Process note: underline_bar.py was written once via an inline Python heredoc that only wrote the file and executed no repository code; all later edits used file tools.
